selection_rule: Explicit technology tier, then As + Tera price, then unit kind, then lowest entity id. Portrait and selection voice share the same leader; command selection order is preserved.
special_rule: After five accepted selections of the same individual, with no gap above 12 seconds; ignore clicks less than .32 seconds apart. One pending response only; finish current line.
alerts: As/Tera/supply/energy/technology/queue/brood shortages, own production/research completion, allied attack/base attack, victory/defeat. High-priority battle narration interrupts selection voice. Attack voice cooldown 10s, spatial minimap rings last 4s, nearby pings merge, maximum 8 active.
limitations: Speech is generated with one local Korean Microsoft Heami voice and distinct pitch/effect profiles; these are not separate actors or externally generated voices.
Citrus roars are procedural sound synthesis, not recorded animal or neural sound-effect performances. Listening approval and final performance polish are outstanding.
No new EXE was exported. This archive is a source patch for the current v0.5 working project, not a standalone game.
Free websites were researched, but no account, API key, or external TTS service was used.
